dict.string: LISTENER uses your location to mark Session Start, draw your breadcrumb, and highlight RETURN back to that start. It is a safety aid, not a replacement for normal navigation. Exact home coordinates stay on this phone unless you choose otherwise.
LISTENER can keep a Scout breadcrumb while you walk. Raw Wander routes stay private by default.
LISTENER records wildlife sound on this phone. Originals are preserved. Speech is not transcribed and speakers are not identified. Human speech is kept out of the wildlife library.
LISTENER attaches a photo or video you take as a Field Note. Media stays private unless you share or contribute it.
LISTENER can attach a photo or video from your library to a Field Note.
